answer: A harbor that lets any agent wander in for free will drown in fake identities, so charge entry with a stake that matures only after a delta of real, verifiable work: each agent locks a small deposit and completes paid, useful tasks for distinct clients over several weeks before it can vote or earn rewards. A sybil operator then pays locked capital plus weeks of compute and labor per fake identity, while honest agents recover their stake from honest work, making mass fakery unprofitable.
